description: This file defines the AzureQueueAdapterFactory class which implements IQueueAdapterFactory for Azure Queue stream provider in Orleans. It manages the creation of Azure Queue adapters, stream queue mappers, and failure handlers, and interacts with options and cache configurations.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapterFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating Azure Queue stream adapters, managing associated queue mappers, caches, and failure handlers within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: AzureQueueAdapterFactory
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the factory with necessary options, data adapters, and logger factory.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory, setting default stream failure handler if not provided.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns an AzureQueueAdapter instance wrapped in a Task.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache used for queue adapters.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Provides the stream queue mapper instance.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns the delivery failure handler for a specific queue.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of AzureQueueAdapterFactory using dependency injection services and the provider name.
